card.name: Capital G or N starting drug names
card.fires_on: A single capital letter G or N that begins a drug or medical term, such as GVOKE, GHB, ganciclovir, nifedipine, norepinephrine, NEXIUM or nephropathy. It is most common in drug-interaction lists.

modes.label: G starting a name
modes.description: The letter G opens a brand or drug name such as Gvoke, GHB, ganciclovir or gastrointestinal.

modes.label: N starting a name
modes.description: The letter N opens a drug name or term such as nifedipine, nisoldipine, norepinephrine, Nexium or nephropathy.

card.writes: It seems to push the model to finish a word that starts with G or N, such as a drug name, and away from words starting with ep or py.
card.plain: It fires on the first capital G or N of a drug name, just as the name begins.
